# regular expression
(?<!s)/[^/]*?\$/

# perl replacement
\bs/[^/]+/[^/]+/

# Git commits
\b[0-9a-f]{40}\b

# README patterns examples
^(?:https\??|data):\S*[*+]$

# perl include flags
-Ilib\b

# dig flags
 \+no

# META.json
"author"  : ".*"

# cspell action.yml entries
^\s*cspell:.*\.txt$

# githubusercontent
/[-a-z0-9]+\.githubusercontent\.com/[-a-zA-Z0-9?&=_\/.]*

# GitHub repositories related references
\bgithub\.com/[-\w]+/[-\w]+(?:/(?:blob|commit|tree|releases)/\w+(?:/|$)|)

# GitHub SHAs (markdown)
(?:\[`?[0-9a-f]+`?\]\(https:/|)/(?:www\.|)github\.com(?:/[^/\s"]+){2,}(?:/[^/\s")]+)(?:[0-9a-f]+(?:[-0-9a-zA-Z/#.]*|)\b|)

# regex
\\b

# search and replace
\bs/.*?/.*?/[g;]

# commits
https://perldoc\.perl\.org/.*

# debian perl packages
\blib[-a-z]+-perl\b

# Perl hex escaped regular expression patterns
\\x\{[0-9A-F]{3,}\}

# GitHub actions
\buses:\s+(['"]?)[-\w.]+/[-\w./]+@[-\w.]+\g{-1}

# Refresh cspell dictionaries commit message
^\* [a-z/.]+$

# Perl warnings
\bexperimental::[a-z_]+\b

# README markdown links
\]\(#[-a-z]+\)

# partial fingerprint
"cs0": ".*?"

# signed off by
Signed-off-by: .*

# Markdown anchors
[#]\w+\)

# perl qr regex
(?<!\$)\bqr(?:\{.*?\}|<.*?>|\(.*?\)|([|!/@#,;']).*?\g{-1})
